plugin.note: Level 8 Dark warriors have huge melee defence (stab +96, slash +79, crush +59) but zero magic and ranged defence, so magic or ranged is by far the fastest style. They have only 17 hitpoints. Bring Wilderness risk gear.

requirements: No combat, Slayer or quest requirement; assigned by Krystilia only.
Kills must occur in the Wilderness to count.
mechanics: Level 8 Dark warriors roam the corridors of the Dark Warriors' Fortress in the low-level Wilderness.
Huge melee defensive bonuses but zero magic/ranged defence.
They attack with slash melee at 4-tick speed.

methods.label: Magic or ranged
methods.summary: Kill the low-hitpoint Dark warriors with magic or ranged against their zero magic/ranged defence.
steps: Travel to the Dark Warriors' Fortress in the low-level Wilderness north-west of Edgeville.
Attack the level 8 Dark warriors with magic or ranged.
Avoid melee - their melee defence is very high.
notes: Take caution: this is a Wilderness PvP zone.

methods.label: Crush melee (fallback)
methods.summary: If meleeing, use a crush weapon against their lowest melee defence (+59); their 17 hitpoints die quickly regardless.
recommendedFor: players without magic or ranged gear
steps: Attack the level 8 Dark warriors with a crush weapon (their weakest melee defence).
notes: Melee is far slower than magic or ranged due to their +96 stab / +79 slash defence.

styleOptions.label: Magic
styleOptions.summary: Magic exploits their zero magic defence.

styleOptions.label: Ranged
styleOptions.summary: Ranged also exploits their zero ranged defence.
